summary: preinstall script fetches and evaluates remote JavaScript at install time
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `node./dist/index.d.js`. That file contains a base64-encoded payload decoded via `Buffer.from(..., 'base64').toString('utf-8')`, and reconstructs the `eval` identifier from the character-code array [101,118,97,108] to evade static detection. The decoded body fetches JavaScript from https://everydaynodechecker-39143n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root2 and passes the response text to `eval`, executing attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine on `npm install`. The obfuscation (base64-wrapped payload plus char-code-assembled `eval`) has no legitimate build purpose and is paired with the remote-fetch-and-execute sink.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
